newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic backs Q1, FY98 EPS views.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic backs Q1, FY98 EPS views.

text.p: Medtronic Inc Chief Financial Officer Robert Ryan said he is comfortable with earnings per share forecasts of $0.62 for the fiscal first quarter, and $2.65 for fiscal 1998.

"I've seen $0.62...We're only a month and a half or so into the year and halfway through the quarter, but I feel pretty comfortable with that," Ryan said at a Piper Jaffray investors conference here Tuesday.
"For the full year, $2.65 is the number I've seen...I'm comfortable with that," Ryan added.
In the year-ago first quarter, Medtronic earned $0.53 a share. For fiscal 1997 ended April 30, it earned $2.22 a share.
Medtronic is the world's largest manufacturer of medical devices.
